segments.source: Cadorna Milk routes milk from a separate container through its Capp-in-Cup system, then dispenses the froth into the drink. It is an option for a household that wants automatic cappuccino and latte macchiato without using the Prestige's integrated carafe. Four profiles keep coffee preferences separate, and ten grinder positions offer more adjustment than the simpler five-step Gaggia automatics. The tube still has to be routed, rinsed and cleaned after milk use; moving the storage outside the machine does not remove that work. Compare the actual one-touch milk choices with the household's orders before paying for the larger Cadorna menu.

segments.context: Cadorna Prestige: the buying decision

segments.source: Prestige is the Cadorna built around a removable milk carafe and the broadest menu in the family. Its current North American Over-Ice revision offers fifteen beverages and four profiles, making it relevant to several people who want their coffee and milk settings saved. Refrigerator storage of the carafe is convenient between drinks, with disassembly and cleaning still part of the routine. Over-Ice should be understood as a hot extraction program for serving over ice, rather than cold brew. The purchase makes most sense when the carafe and wider milk menu will be used frequently enough to justify their care.
